title: F169 the framework's site, as the design review picked it: the overview
caption: Six children, in order, each its own plan, branch and pull request: the values first, then the page, the brand, the depth, the phone and the share card.

cards.title: F169 The design review's picks, built
cards.text: Thirteen findings, each picked by Louis from three options drawn on the real pages, built in six small features.

cards.title: F169.1 Flat's lines and inks
cards.text: Dark's line firmer, the faint grey readable and held by a test, the ring whole, a code word on a grey chip.

cards.title: F169.2 The docs page's type and edges
cards.text: Headings at 74, 40 and 28, rows that read as the steps do, four named corner sizes.

cards.title: F169.3 The brand's parts
cards.text: The mark on Orbi and above the Overview's first words, the name's ball one size, the footer in one row.

cards.title: F169.4 Flat has no depth
cards.text: No shadow, blur or glow on a flat page, and a picture drawn with no fade.

cards.title: F169.5 The phone
cards.text: The nine pages in the header's menu, the words 24 from the edge, pictures drawn for a phone.

cards.title: F169.6 A card for each page
cards.text: A link to any of the nine pages previews that page's own card.
